content: QuPath coordinate export units: QuPath exports centroid coordinates as 'Centroid X µm' and 'Centroid Y µm' when pixel calibration is set correctly, or as raw pixel values when calibration is missing. OME-TIFF physical pixel size must be present in the OME-XML PhysicalSizeX field for QuPath to calibrate automatically. ABBA atlas coordinate export produces Atlas_X/Y/Z in millimeters (not microns). Allen CCFv3 native unit is micrometers. Therefore: ABBA mm coordinates must be multiplied by 1000 before passing to brainrender, which expects CCFv3 microns. A coordinate landing outside the brain atlas in brainrender is a symptom of a units mismatch (factor of ~1000 off).
